en: Black‑and‑white postcard view over a European town with dense late‑19th/early‑20th‑century apartment blocks and large barracks buildings. In the foreground are landscaped park grounds, footpaths, and a pond or small lake with boats and a boathouse. The town stretches across a low valley with church towers and factory chimneys visible in the distance. Printed caption text appears at the bottom left, and a red number is written at the top right margin.
